title: Many Labs 2: preregistered multi-effect replication across samples and settings
summary: Promotes Many Labs 2 as a high-powered boundary-map record. It provides effect-level outcomes, large sample coverage, and shrinkage estimates while preserving the warning that sample/setting tests are not universal context tests.

status_history.note: Promoted or created in rev0012 multi-lab replication / boundary-map pass.

status_cautions: strict and conventional significance both recorded

handling_notes: Avoid turning replication into researcher humiliation or field dismissal.
Preserve the difference between failed, narrowed, inconclusive, and robust effects.
Do not promote clinical, educational, or policy implications beyond the source-backed record scope.

unknowns: No full child-record extraction of each original study, lab, dataset, and author response in this revision.
No local archived copy or full line-by-line source edition yet.
Future revisions should add post-RRR/meta-analytic status histories and field/practice lag checks.
next_actions: Create child records for each included original effect where source permanence and author-response materials justify it.
Add negative controls and successful controls from additional fields.
Separate direct replication, conceptual replication, reproducibility, and generalizability claims in later records.
